purpose: Capability matrix for reproducing approved wformat C++ behavior through the custom clang-format extension layer.

proofCommands.normalizer-only: py -c "from pathlib import Path; from wformat.normalizer import fix_with_tree_sitter; p=Path(r'tests\wformat-style-gaps\cases'); assert fix_with_tree_sitter((p/'wrapped-function-name-normalizer.input.cpp').read_text()) == (p/'wrapped-function-name.normalizer.cpp').read_text()"

auditSummary.assignmentMethod: Residual hunks are assigned by repeated token/layout behavior using the fixture sections and anchors recorded on each finding. Repeated closing-parenthesis hunks account for most occurrences.

existingOptionFindings.name: Return type on its own line
existingOptionFindings.classification: already supported by an existing option

proof.observed: The closest clang configuration emits the same return-type break; no engine extension is needed.

existingOptionFindings.name: Allman braces and inserted control-statement braces
existingOptionFindings.nearestClangOption: BreakBeforeBraces: Allman; InsertBraces: true; AllowShort*OnASingleLine: Never
existingOptionFindings.classification: already supported by an existing option

proof.observed: The closest clang output inserts the same braces. Residual differences in this case are blank-line policy and closing-parenthesis indentation.

existingOptionFindings.name: One parameter or argument per line after a list wraps
existingOptionFindings.nearestClangOption: BinPackParameters: OnePerLine; BinPackArguments: false; AllowAll*OnNextLine: false
existingOptionFindings.classification: already supported by an existing option

proof.observed: Existing options control packing once a list wraps, but they cannot force every short signature or call to wrap.

existingOptionFindings.name: No space before inheritance and constructor-initializer colons
existingOptionFindings.classification: already supported by an existing option

proof.observed: The closest configuration reproduces the colon spacing. Continuation indentation remains a separate gap.

existingOptionFindings.name: Requires clause aligned with the declaration

fixtureReferences.anchor: qualified Collect, operator(), and conversion definitions
decltype, explicit-object, static-operator, and pack-indexing declarations and definitions

existingOptionFindings.classification: already supported by an existing option

proof.observed: Clause indentation is supported; requires-expression braces and ref-qualifier layout are not.

existingOptionFindings.name: Do not indent a wrapped function name under its return type

proof.observed: The direct normalizer case removes four leading spaces from the wrapped name. The same intended result is already available through IndentWrappedFunctionNames: false.

existingOptionFindings.name: Broad space before C++ braced lists
existingOptionFindings.classification: already supported by an existing option

proof.observed: The existing boolean applies to all C++ braced lists. Wformat distinguishes member initializers, named variables, temporary objects, return braced lists, and nested aggregates.

existingOptionFindings.name: Consecutive declaration and assignment alignment

fixtureReferences.anchor: TrailingCommentRecord bit-field, member, and trailing-comment alignment

existingOptionFindings.classification: already supported by an existing option

proof.observed: Existing alignment options align a wider set of adjacent declarations and compound assignments than wformat. Wformat starts and ends groups at different declaration-category boundaries.

existingOptionFindings.name: Blank lines around access modifiers and definition blocks
existingOptionFindings.classification: already supported by an existing option

proof.observed: Existing options cover structural boundaries, but not wformat's statement-category blank lines such as before return and before or after individual control statements.

existingOptionFindings.name: Use a space only for Q_FOREACH among configured control macros

proof.observed: Classifying Q_FOREACH as an IfMacro and KJ_IF_MAYBE as a ForEachMacro permits AfterIfMacros: true with AfterForeachMacros: false. The expanded full fixture changes only the intended Q_FOREACH spacing.

existingOptionFindings.name: Treat a standalone empty marker macro as a complete statement

proof.observed: Adding WFORMAT_EMPTY_MARKER to StatementMacros changes only its four-line region, prevents clang-format from treating the following declaration as a continuation, and exactly matches WFormat there.

LLVM 20.1.8 natively preserves spaces around deduction-guide, function trailing-return, and compound-requirement arrows. Removing the rejected WFormat-tightening override produces the reviewed target without a custom option.

unsupportedDesired.name: Indent a multiline closing parenthesis to the parameter or argument column

fixtureReferences.anchor: complex function-definition collision suite declarations and definitions
modern decltype, explicit-object, static-operator, pack-indexing, and reasoned-delete signatures

proof.observed: Wformat places ')' at the same indentation as list items. Exhaustive probes of Align, DontAlign, AlwaysBreak, and BlockIndent either keep ')' with the last item or place it at the enclosing declaration/call indentation. This is the dominant repeated residual family.

unsupportedDesired.name: Force non-empty function declarations and definitions into multiline form

fixtureReferences.anchor: modern decltype, explicit-object, static-operator, pack-indexing, and reasoned-delete suite

proof.observed: BreakFunctionDefinitionParameters forces ordinary definitions but not declarations. On the expanded full fixture it also incorrectly wraps alignas, explicit(bool), noexcept expressions, macro arguments, and parts of the complex definition suites. AlwaysOnePerLine leaves the first and every single parameter inline. The fixture now covers stacked template heads, leading and trailing nested decltype returns, namespace/class/nested-class qualified names, explicit object parameters, static operators, constraints, function-try-block constructors, pointer-to-member parameters, and C++26 pack indexing.

fixtureReferences.anchor: eight comment-separated qualified definitions in the collision suite

proof.observed: IndentWrappedFunctionNames false already deindents an ordinary wrapped name, but both true and false leave comment-separated namespace and class-template qualifier lines indented by ContinuationIndentWidth. Setting ContinuationIndentWidth to 0 also removes all parameter continuation indentation, so no existing option produces the complete WFormat shape.

unsupportedDesired.name: Break constexpr constructors and virtual destructors after the specifier

proof.observed: BreakAfterReturnType does not model constructor or destructor specifiers because these declarations have no return type. BreakFunctionDefinitionParameters can wrap constructor parameters but does not break after constexpr or virtual.

unsupportedDesired.name: Insert spaces after parenthesized declaration-specifier keywords

proof.observed: BeforeNonEmptyParentheses produces 'explicit (condition)' and 'delete (reason)', but also changes ordinary non-empty calls, declarations, and constructor initializers. The custom parenthesis-spacing structure has no explicit(bool)- or C++26 delete-with-reason-specific field.

fixtureReferences.anchor: template-template parameter, variadic handler/context packs, and qualified operator() definition
C++26 expression/type pack indexing and variadic friend declaration

proof.observed: Wformat emits 'typename ... Values' and 'operator() ...' while retaining 'Values&&... values' and 'sizeof...(values)'. Its C++26 output also distinguishes type pack indexing, expression pack indexing, and variadic friends. The complete LLVM 20.1.8 spacing surface has no ellipsis fields that express those contexts independently.

unsupportedDesired.name: SAL annotation and function-pointer declarator spacing

proof.observed: Generic non-empty-parenthesis spacing and PointerAlignment approximate individual tokens, but also space ordinary calls and cannot independently distinguish the function-pointer grouping parenthesis, the callback parameter list, and selected SAL annotation arguments.

unsupportedDesired.name: Choose brace spacing and line breaks by initializer context

fixtureReferences.anchor: designated and positional mixed aggregate constructors and factories across root, layer, branch, and leaf

proof.observed: Wformat distinguishes member initializers ('point_{...}'), named local objects ('Point local {...}'), temporary construction ('Point {...}'), and return braced lists ('return {...}'). SpaceBeforeCpp11BracedList and Cpp11BracedListStyle are global.

fixtureReferences.anchor: deduced_matrix, deduced_tensor, commented_tensor, ArrayTensor3D, built_in_tensor, and DeepAggregateVolume
designated_mixed and positional_mixed root, layer, branch, leaf, and nested expression arrays

proof.observed: The reviewed policy renders each structural aggregate as an aligned brace scope while keeping scalar leaf rows compact. Native AlignArrayOfStructures continues to own two-level matrices.

unsupportedDesired.name: Break requires-expression braces and requirements in wformat form

proof.observed: No BraceWrapping field targets a requires-expression body. AllowShortCompoundRequirementOnASingleLine: false only expands the inner expression into its own brace block rather than wformat's layout; the modern suite repeats the gap inside explicit-object and static-operator declarations and definitions.

unsupportedDesired.name: Put a ref qualifier and trailing requires clause on dedicated lines

fixtureReferences.anchor: Workflow::Stage::Collect const-ref qualifier and trailing requires
DispatchTable::OverloadSet::operator() rvalue qualifier and trailing requires

proof.observed: RequiresClausePosition controls whether the requires clause has its own line, but Wformat emits get(), then '& requires(I < N)' on the following line. No existing option controls the preceding ref-qualifier boundary.

unsupportedDesired.name: Insert a blank line before return except immediately after an opening brace

proof.observed: Clang-format preserves some existing blank lines but has no rule that inserts one based on a return statement's predecessor.

unsupportedDesired.name: Insert blank lines before and after selected control statements

proof.observed: Wformat has separate before/after policies for if, for, while, switch, synchronized, and related statements. Existing blank-line options do not operate at statement category granularity.

unsupportedDesired.name: Align object-like macro replacements across conditional directives

proof.observed: AlignConsecutiveMacros stops at #if/#else/#endif boundaries. Wformat retains one alignment column across those directives.

unsupportedDesired.name: Keep #else and #endif comments out of nearby trailing-comment alignment groups

fixtureReferences.anchor: platform, direct, and continued conditional groups

proof.observed: AlignTrailingComments exposes only Kind and OverEmptyLines. Always aligns #else/#endif comments with neighboring directives, while Leave or Never also loses desired alignment elsewhere. WFormat instead leaves these closing-directive comments one space after the directive.

unsupportedDesired.name: Indent an attributed label with the surrounding function body

proof.observed: With both IndentGotoLabels: false and true, a standard attribute causes the label to remain flush left. The option does not produce the requested attributed-label result.

unsupportedDesired.name: Insert blank lines before and after non-case labels

proof.observed: The minimized case adds one empty line on both sides of done:. Clang-format has no label-specific blank-line option.

unsupportedDesired.name: Compact a multiline call whose only argument is one expression

proof.observed: The uncrustify-to-final diff has one hunk: take(1 + 2) is compacted after the earlier stage forced it multiline. AlignAfterOpenBracket, BinPackArguments, AllowAllArgumentsOnNextLine, and penalty probes all preserve the source-induced break, so existing call options cannot express this exception together with force-multiline calls.

unsupportedDesired.name: Lowercase base prefixes and uppercase hex digits and integer suffixes

proof.observed: The uncrustify-to-final diff changes 0Xdeadbeeful to 0xDEADBEEFUL. The LLVM 20.1.8 option surface contains IntegerLiteralSeparator for digit grouping but no prefix, hexadecimal-digit, or suffix case control.

reviewedPresetRules.name: Expand lambda signatures for multiple statements or column overflow
reviewedPresetRules.trigger: multiple statement terminators on one physical lambda-body line or lambda expression width greater than ColumnLimit

proof.observed: A fitting one-statement lambda stays compact; multiple statements and an overflowing lambda use the reviewed parameter and body-scope indentation.

reviewedPresetRules.name: Expand overflowing ternaries into fully vertical form
reviewedPresetRules.trigger: ternary range width greater than the continuation width available under ColumnLimit

proof.observed: A fitting ternary stays compact; an overflowing ternary places its condition, operators, and operands on independent continuation lines.

reviewedPresetRules.name: Separate completed braced switch cases
reviewedPresetRules.nearestClangOption: EmptyLineBeforeAccessModifier and SeparateDefinitionBlocks do not apply to case labels
reviewedPresetRules.trigger: a case or default label follows a completed braced case block

proof.observed: Exactly one empty line separates consecutive completed braced case blocks, without inserting space between a label and its opening brace.

reviewedPresetRules.name: Expand overflowing nested templates as indentation scopes
reviewedPresetRules.trigger: nested-template range width greater than ColumnLimit

proof.observed: A fitting nested template stays compact; an overflowing range expands every argument scope and aligns each closing > with that scope.

excludedBehaviors.name: Force fitting function calls and macro invocations into multiline form

proof.observed: The oracle forces fitting calls to wrap, but the reviewed product style wraps calls only under ColumnLimit pressure or ProgressiveCallExpansion. Definition and declaration signatures remain forced by ForceMultilineFunctionSignatures.

excludedBehaviors.name: Insert spaces before inline-asm and constraint parentheses

proof.observed: The oracle spaces GNU asm and constraint parentheses, but inline assembly is outside the reviewed product scope. Native clang-format behavior is retained.

excludedBehaviors.name: Align declarations and assignments using wformat syntax-context boundaries

proof.observed: The oracle aligns declarations and assignments across syntax-aware groups, but the reviewed product style requires assignments to remain unaligned. AlignConsecutiveAssignments.Enabled remains false.

excludedBehaviors.name: Choose leading or trailing breaks by binary-operator category

proof.observed: The oracle chooses leading or trailing placement by operator category, but the reviewed style relies on native BreakBeforeBinaryOperators/BreakBinaryOperations plus ProgressiveArithmeticExpansion.

excludedBehaviors.name: Indent continued expressions by semantic level instead of operand alignment

proof.observed: The option mainly affected wrapped calls and expressions. Calls now wrap only naturally or through ProgressiveCallExpansion, arithmetic is owned by ProgressiveArithmeticExpansion, ternaries showed no distinct benefit, and Boolean indentation was undesirable.

excludedBehaviors.name: Insert a space between a lambda capture list and its parameter list

proof.observed: The WFormat oracle inserts a space after the lambda capture list, but the reviewed product style intentionally keeps standard compact lambda spelling.

excludedBehaviors.name: Break before a legacy dynamic throw exception specification
excludedBehaviors.nearestClangOption: BreakBeforeNoexceptSpecifier does not apply to throw(type)

proof.observed: The legacy throw(type) layout is not part of the approved native style scope.

excludedBehaviors.name: Insert parentheses throughout Boolean expressions
excludedBehaviors.nearestClangOption: RemoveParentheses is inverse-only and warns about semantic risk

proof.observed: Uncrustify inserts parentheses in conditions, assignments, and returns. This changes the token stream rather than whitespace and is outside the initial native-style scope.

excludedBehaviors.name: Remove the final enumerator comma
excludedBehaviors.nearestClangOption: InsertTrailingCommas is JavaScript-only and has no C++ removal mode

proof.observed: The comma is removed by mod_enum_last_comma, not by a formatting-only clang option.

excludedBehaviors.name: Rewrite for(;;) and other infinite-loop forms as while (true)

proof.observed: mod_infinite_loop changes control-flow syntax. The minimized case proves for(;;) becomes while (true).

excludedBehaviors.name: Remove arbitrary extra semicolons
excludedBehaviors.nearestClangOption: RemoveSemicolon only handles semicolons after function and constructor/destructor bodies

proof.observed: mod_remove_extra_semicolon removes standalone extra semicolons beyond clang-format's narrowly documented RemoveSemicolon behavior.

excludedBehaviors.name: Add a source comment to #else after a long branch
excludedBehaviors.nearestClangOption: FixNamespaceComments only handles namespace closing braces

proof.observed: At the configured 40-line threshold, uncrustify changes '#else' to '#else // if defined(WFORMAT_LONG_BRANCH)'.

excludedBehaviors.name: Replace tab characters inside string literal contents

proof.observed: The bundled string_replace_tab_chars setting edits literal contents. It is excluded even though the canonical fixture has no active delta for it.

excludedBehaviors.name: Remove the final newline from formatter output
excludedBehaviors.nearestClangOption: InsertNewlineAtEOF only inserts; it does not request removal

proof.observed: The Python normalizer uses strip(), making newline removal an implementation artifact rather than an intended C++ style.

oracleLimitationsAndDefects.name: Uncrustify exits with code 70 on if consteval
oracleLimitationsAndDefects.nearestClangOption: not applicable; clang-format 20.1.8 parses the syntax

proof.observed: The clang stage succeeds; uncrustify 0.81.0 exits 70 with empty diagnostics. The full fixture requires INDENT-OFF around this syntax.

oracleLimitationsAndDefects.name: Uncrustify can hang after accumulated modern-C++ parser state

proof.observed: Earlier delta-debugging isolated a hang that depends on prior parser state around an optional comparison. The audit harness timeout converts it to an explicit failure.

oracleLimitationsAndDefects.name: Asymmetric missing spaces around arithmetic operators
oracleLimitationsAndDefects.nearestClangOption: SpacesInAngles and ordinary binary-operator spacing already produce the correct result

proof.observed: Examples include 'x* s', 'pi_v<double>/ 6.0', and 'tuple_size_v<...>+flat_map'. These are inconsistent parser artifacts, not a coherent style.
The oracle emits 'std::byte * output' despite its otherwise left-aligned pointer style.

oracleLimitationsAndDefects.name: Cramped C++23 attributed-lambda output
oracleLimitationsAndDefects.nearestClangOption: SpaceBeforeParens and SpacesInParens produce syntactically spaced output

proof.observed: The oracle emits 'static noexcept->int{return ...;}' for an attributed lambda. This conflicts with its normal arrow and brace spacing.
The oracle emits 'decltype(auto)first_value', which is an accidental token-spacing error.

fixtureReferences.anchor: explicit object parameter declarations and definitions

proof.observed: Most forwarding references remain 'T&&', but selected parser contexts become 'T &&', including only some explicit-object declarations/definitions and C++26 pack-indexed references. The exact inconsistency is not a coherent style.

oracleLimitationsAndDefects.name: Misindent selected complex constexpr auto declaration names
oracleLimitationsAndDefects.nearestClangOption: IndentWrappedFunctionNames: false and ordinary trailing-return arrow spacing

proof.observed: For a constexpr auto declaration, adding either a free/member-function-pointer parameter or an explicit object parameter makes the oracle indent the wrapped function name by four spaces and collapse ') -> Result' to ')->Result'. The minimized case isolates the function-pointer trigger, while ModernAccessor::Project in the full fixture supplies the explicit-object trigger; plain declarations and matching definitions stay aligned.

oracleLimitationsAndDefects.name: Overindent the second base class in a multiline inheritance list

proof.observed: The minimized oracle output indents First by four spaces and Second by eight. The exact asymmetry is rejected even though inheritance continuation policy remains an implementation area.
The oracle places the colon after a space and the base name at column zero, unlike both its ordinary inheritance style and valid clang-format output.

oracleLimitationsAndDefects.name: Outdent a block comment inside a do-while macro body

proof.observed: The comment is indented less than the statement immediately below it inside the same macro body. This isolated inconsistency is not treated as a style feature.

oracleLimitationsAndDefects.name: Remove the separator before comments after null directives and macro-generated case labels

proof.observed: The clang-format stage keeps a separator in '# // comment' and 'WFORMAT_CASE(0): // comment', but uncrustify emits '#// comment' and 'WFORMAT_CASE(0):// comment'. Both spellings compile, but they violate the target one-space trailing-comment policy and are not native style requirements.
